Look at the stderr for each DXC pane. Neither should print any diagnostic at all: the
shader compiles clean with no `-Wcomma-in-init` warning for `uint2 a = (1, 2) / 2;`,
even though the comma pair is very likely a forgotten `uint2(...)` constructor call.
Compare this with the Clang pane (the from-scratch HLSL front end being developed in
upstream llvm-project, a different codebase from this DXC repository): check whether
it diagnoses the nested comma expression here, since a maintainer comment on the issue
says Clang currently warns "in these cases".
